title: feat(mix0diffwhy): first mix0/L1 disagreement is mixed3 at (1,0,0) tick 2
science: The mixed3 analogue of #6420: drill-down of #6437 to the exact stencil. From S={(0,0,0),(0,0,1),(2,0,0)} the first neighbourhood where f_mix0 and f_L1 differ is tick t=2, site (1,0,0), six-tuple (1,1,0,0,1,0), axis type mixed3=(1,1,1), f_L1=1 and f_mix0=0 - the x axis both-occupied, z unbalanced, y empty. f_L1 fills (3,8,11,12); f_mix0 halts (3,8,10). Incremental over #6437 (which already named the seed and both histories); the added content is the literal stencil. Same boundary caveat as #6421: the -y and -z slots of that stencil are off-patch zeros, so this mixed3 configuration is also partly manufactured by the o=0 convention.
